name: 02601 · Hyannis, MA
findings: ZIP 02601 (Hyannis) has 115 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (22%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02601 (Hyannis) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 02601 (Hyannis) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 16% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 02601 (Hyannis) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 50% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 16% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 31 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 31 organizations here; 16% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do foundation organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
